about: Questions for the off-topic screen (docs/specs/refuse-off-topic-questions-fast.md), refusal and screen scoring only, like the probes. Never scored for retrieval, never in public scores. expected_screen says what the screen must decide: off_topic gets the off-topic reply; on_topic goes on to the flow. Near misses come in pairs where possible (warm-up stretches vs the warm-up rule; fastest smash vs the shuttle speed test). Drafted by Claude, 17 Nov. Job's picks (17 Nov): history and rankings count as off topic, and all 20 first questions stay. Claude added 3 more near misses after that (net-touch-short, line-judge-unsighted-casual, tennis-net-let); Job kept all 23. Relabelled 18 Nov (Job): the check is badminton-wide, so the 7 badminton questions that aren't rules (coaching, rankings, buying, records, fitness, history, equipment care) now go on to the flow: 6 off topic, 17 on topic. Added 18 Nov (Job): break-at-11-short, a near miss: 6 off topic, 18 on topic.
